correctness.rationale: Fully specified deterministic state invariant tracks accumulated parity for each connected frontier component. The 19-state 119-transition transfer, exact characteristic polynomial and Perron root >6 are reconstructed by code and reasoned from union operations, with complete old-component closure checks. All finite strip words have at most four-column legal finite extensions, so finite-board counts determine genuine shift entropy. Four-row striped embedding yields the area-normalized planar bound. Code independently brute checks all boards and padding through five columns; proof handles all widths.
